headline: Copper Falls Below $12,000 per Ton on Doubts Over AI Infrastructure Demand
summary: Copper futures declined below $12,000 per metric ton as investors questioned the timing of AI data center capital outlays and cited weak industrial consumption in China. Concerns over global market balances also pressured prices.
why: Copper is a major industrial commodity and global economic barometer, used extensively in electronics, grid infrastructure, and construction.

impacts.name: Copper
impacts.why: Copper fell below $12,000 per ton as demand expectations for AI data centers softened.
